pages.text: Basic Dust can now be turned into the first useful materials, including iron.$(br2)The central device of this stage is the $(l:dust/integrated_block)Integrated Block$(/l), which recombines ingredients placed in fixed positions.$(br)For a route to lava, see $(l:dust/lava)Making Lava$(/l).

Four $(item)Integrated Frame Tier 1$() blocks extend the Integrated Block.$(br2)An $(l:ash/ash_collector)Ash Collector$(/l) gathers Ash from a burning furnace. That Ash can enter Raw Ash Steel, which is then smelted into Ash Steel Ingots.

The $(l:dust/milling_machine)Milling and Assembly Machine$(/l) performs grinding and assembly recipes.$(br)It also provides the materials needed for the next Integrated Frame and more complex combinations.
